Hero_Desc_Sari:
You can't tell what kind of phantom Sari is.
She is obsessed with empathizing and going along with the conversation and actions of other phantoms, so maybe this is a clue?
Album_Hobby_Sari: Going Around Looking for Someone Who Will Play Along
Album_Sari1: Sari enjoys giving enthusiastic responses to what others say. She carefully chooses her words to be what the other wants to hear most.
Album_Sari2: Most find Sari's endless praise overwhelming. Perhaps she enjoys seeing their reactions... after all, phantoms do love playing tricks.
Album_Sari3: Surprisingly her reactions seemingly filled with positivity do not seem to land well with many people. Her praise is so excessive that it comes across as mockery. Only those starved for compliments truly appreciate it.
Album_Sari4: While Sari constantly agrees with others, she surprisingly never initiates conversations. It's cute to see her at a loss when someone stays absolutely silent in front of her.
Album_Sari5: Surprisingly, Sari's reactions aren't just pranks! The exaggerated way in which she expresses herself just makes it hard for others to understand her. She says these reactions partly come out instinctively.
Album_Sari6: Sari frequently visits Monatium to talk with the machines. It's somewhat pitiful to see her enthusiastically applauding and praising automatic responses from kiosks and robot vacuum cleaners.
Album_Sari7: No matter what pranks other phantoms pull, Sari praises them saying it was such an excellent game plan, which confuses the other. The phantom receiving the praise thinks the prank failed, turning away sadly, and seeing this, Sari also becomes depressed wondering if she misspoke.
LoveHero_Sari:
If you need a reaction,
you've come to the right place!
LoveHeroCancel_Sari:
An audience knows
when to leave.
Food_ChefNote_Sari_Hate1: She seems unsure of how to react, calling the food bland and boring.
Food_ChefNote_Sari_Hate2: She looked confused, questioning if this could even be called food.
Food_ChefNote_Sari_Like1: She must have found the preparation process fun, clapping enthusiastically as the dish was finished with a blowtorch.
Food_ChefNote_Sari_Like2: She admired how different ingredients came together into one beautiful creation.
Food_ChefNote_Sari_Like3: She says it is a fun dish filled with care, from ingredient prep to completion.
Food_ChefNote_Sari_Like4: With a vacant look, she watched me prepare it, clearly enjoying herself.
Food_ChefNote_Sari_Like5: She called it a magnificent stage prop, saying she wanted to scatter it around every time she made an appearance.
Food_ChefNote_Sari_Like6: Since she wanted to try kneading the dough, we made it together. It turned out to be a mess, but she had a great time.
Food_ChefNote_Sari_Like7: She played with it, rolling the chocolate around until it melted and was gone.
Food_ChefNote_Sari_Like8: Covering her hands in glue. she haphazardly sticks powder on them, saying it was super pretty.
Food_ChefNote_Sari_Like9: Whenever a candy with a different shape appeared, she put on a show, giving each one a different reaction.
Gacha_Result_Line1_Sari: Start off by floating an idea.
Sari_Growth: I am Sari. What is your name?
Sari_Defeat1: I guess I'm not the main character after all...
Sari_Defeat2: Sari... You must live a long and happy life!
Sari_Affinity1_1: So cool! What is cool, you ask? Everything is cool!
Sari_Affinity1_2: This is so fun!! The story's tight and well-paced!!
Sari_Affinity2: What kind of phantom am I...? Do I... really have to talk about it...?
Sari_Affinity1_3: How can this be... I am amazed that such a thing could happen!
Sari_Affinity3: I enjoy listening to other's stories. Books? You cannot have a conversation with books!
Sari_Affinity4: If someone just keeps repeating the same thing, I eventually run out of ways to react. It's pretty awkward.
Sari_Affinity5: You hit it off, say goodbye... and somehow it's awkward the next time you meet. Is that just me?
Sari_Affinity6: Please keep talking at me. Do not ask me questions. I do not need such refined conversational skills!
Sari_Affinity7: Talking first and actually getting praised isn't so bad... once or twice a century!
Sari_Die2: Gotta quit while I'm ahead... // Time for my exit...!
Sari_DeckSetting2: You want me to go too?
Sari_Touch1_2: Uhh... what kind of reaction do you want?
Sari_Touch2: H-How should I react to this?
Sari_Touch2_2: Hehe, that was good. One more!
Sari_Birthday: What? It is your birthday? Really? Huge congratulations!
Sari_Gacha2: Start off by floating an idea.
Sari_Gacha3: Would you tell me about yourself first?
Sari_Line1: Is there anyone good to talk to?
Sari_Line3: I wonder where Lady Shady is?
LoveLetter_Sari: Hi there, Master! What a pleasure! Writing letters is so difficult when I can't see your reactions to what I'm saying. But right now, I'm imagining a conversation with you while I write! Oh, now you're talking about that crème brûlée you had yesterday. Wow, amazing! That must have been SO good! You're so good at explaining things. Hmm, still... it is a bit awkward having a conversation with the imaginary version of you. I would much prefer to meet you face to face as usual! Come back soon and share some fun stories, okay?
LoveCall_Sari:
Hello, Master~ It is Sari~
Now then, Sari made the call, so you do the talking, Master~
...Hmm? I called, so why should you have to talk? Wow~ So fussy~ You even question something like that? You are a total fussy little bean~
I do not have much to say. I simply wanted to hear your voice!
Reacting to the things you say is even, even more fun than reacting to everyone else~
...Wow~ You are flustered again! If this is awkward, you could just hang up, silly~ So cute~!
Hehe, Veruna and Maison only ever get annoyed with me~ But even when I cling to you like this, you react so well to Sari's reactions. I like that.
You secretly think Sari is fun too, right? I can keep clinging to you~?
If you do not dislike it, you may pet me even more the next time I cling to you~!
I will take that to mean you like it too! So take good care of me next time, Master~!
Affinity_Sari_EP01_001: I got cast as a performer in Epica's play. What should I do...?
Affinity_Sari_EP01_003: Thank you for congratulating me!! ...No way, I'm just worried about what to do.
Affinity_Sari_EP01_004: Show me what role you got with your acting.
Affinity_Sari_EP01_005: Sari acts like a tree swaying in the wind, raising both arms, shaking them, and making some noise.
Affinity_Sari_EP01_006: Why did you accept it if it's so burdensome?
Affinity_Sari_EP01_007: I've always gone along with others, so I can't refuse....
Affinity_Sari_EP02_001: It's an important thing to express your true feelings.
Affinity_Sari_EP02_002: Can you tell me casually what's on your mind?
Affinity_Sari_EP02_003: The food tastes bad. Try harder. ... You mean saying like this honestly?
Affinity_Sari_EP02_004: How have you been handling things until now?
Affinity_Sari_EP02_005: When I need to say something, I avoid it as much as possible.
Affinity_Sari_EP02_006: Now you want to express yourself more?
Affinity_Sari_EP02_007: Not really, but just in case.
Affinity_Sari_EP03_001: I once went along with Rim's jokes, and now she comes every day with lame jokes.
Affinity_Sari_EP03_002: It must be tough to hear those jokes every day.
Affinity_Sari_EP03_003: But she got so happy when I pretended to go along with her jokes.
Affinity_Sari_EP03_004: Did you learn any jokes? Want to share one?
Affinity_Sari_EP03_005: That was something beyond my level. A regular phantom like me can't even think about it.
Affinity_Sari_EP03_006: You've become friends with Rim. Sari, you're so kind.
Affinity_Sari_EP03_007: You called a phantom kind, Master... You're amazing.
Affinity_Sari_EP04_001: Today has been a tough day with all the bumping around.
Affinity_Sari_EP04_002: I was also exhausted writing 100 pages of The Master's Diary today.
Affinity_Sari_EP04_003: Wow. You had a lot happening to write even 100 pages.
Affinity_Sari_EP04_004: I was exhausted, because so many Apostles visit the Banquet Hall.
Affinity_Sari_EP04_005: Even though it was tough, you kept working. That's amazing!
Affinity_Sari_EP04_006: You look tired. Rest as much as you want.
Affinity_Sari_EP04_007: Wow! I'm touched! Thank you, Master.
Affinity_Sari_EP05_002: Actually, I'm a raccoon flying in the sky, vanquishing evil!
Affinity_Sari_EP05_003: Wow. You're a raccoon, Master!! That's so cool!
Affinity_Sari_EP05_005: Wow! You love me... Wait, that's nonsense.
Affinity_Sari_EP05_006: Actually, this world is just a collection of data made up of 0s and 1s!
Affinity_Sari_EP05_007: Wow! I don't get it, but it sounds cool anyway!
Affinity_Sari_EP06_001: I hate old boomer types like Ifrit! I'll tease her badly!
Affinity_Sari_EP06_002: No! Don't do that! Then everything will burn!
Affinity_Sari_EP06_003: Do I have to care about it? I'll do whatever I want!
Affinity_Sari_EP06_004: What if Ifrit burns you up?
Affinity_Sari_EP06_005: A burning phantom... It sounds like I can become much cooler, but also more noticeable, I guess?
Affinity_Sari_EP06_006: You've really seen Ifrit's fiery personality.
Affinity_Sari_EP06_007: To see the fiery personality in VIP seat, I feel honored!
Affinity_Sari_EP07_001: Who should I talk to for an interesting reaction?
Affinity_Sari_EP07_003: If I go along with the Sprite Queen, she gets angry, jumping around or ridiculously showing off at a high chance.
Affinity_Sari_EP07_005: Well, no matter how I go along, her expression doesn't change much...
Affinity_Sari_EP07_007: The silver dragon...? When I went along, she got all proud, but then got flustered, her tongue tangled up. However, she didn't try to avoid the conversation....
Affinity_Sari_EP08_001: I heard there's a job where you can make money just by going along with people's words.
Affinity_Sari_EP08_002: It exists on Earth. It's called an audience part-time job.
Affinity_Sari_EP08_003: It's amazing to get paid for playing. I hope the Order make something like that.
Affinity_Sari_EP08_004: Do you want me to set up such an event for you?
Affinity_Sari_EP08_005: N-No, that's fine... I'll consider it, if a natural opportunity comes.
Affinity_Sari_EP08_006: Sari, even if you're good at going along, you might get tired in the end.
Affinity_Sari_EP08_007: Are you trying to provoke me, Master?
Affinity_Sari_EP09_001: I've dragged to the Werebeast Village for some reason and talked all day, so my throat hurts...
Affinity_Sari_EP09_002: I know, werebeasts never stop talking nonsense.
Affinity_Sari_EP09_003: Werebeasts are amazing. I admit them.
Affinity_Sari_EP09_004: Get some warm lemon tea and relieve the fatigue.
Affinity_Sari_EP09_005: I can't taste it, but I feel better now.
Affinity_Sari_EP09_006: You don't have to go along with anything, when you're with me.
Affinity_Sari_EP09_007: Wow, you're really kind, Master! ... See? It just comes out habitually.
Affinity_Sari_EP10_001: If there's a story with an extra as the main character, would it be interesting?
Affinity_Sari_EP10_002: It might end up being too boring.
Affinity_Sari_EP10_004: Every being is the main character in their own life.
Affinity_Sari_EP10_005: Do you think of me as the main character too?
Affinity_Sari_EP10_006: Being the main character would just be tiring.
Affinity_Sari_EP10_007: Master, you can say that because you're sort of the main character in Elias.
Affinity_Sari_EP11_001: Master! You look so cool and handsome today!
Affinity_Sari_EP11_002: My dark circles go down to my chin. You're making fun of me, aren't you?
Affinity_Sari_EP11_005: Bold as ever! That's why you're the Master! Awesome!
Affinity_Sari_EP11_007: Oh? Ah... Not like that. The conversation just died...!
Affinity_Sari_EP12_001: As Master, you must have to speak in front of denizens a lot, right?
Affinity_Sari_EP12_002: They all treat me like I'm nothing, so my schedule's pretty light.
Affinity_Sari_EP12_003: Well. That kind of reply really kills the conversation.
Affinity_Sari_EP12_004: Yeah. Give me some tips on what to do.
Affinity_Sari_EP12_005: Me, start the conversation? The first punch isn't really my thing, so... yeah, no clue.
Affinity_Sari_EP12_006: Powerful speeches are what I use to win over the people of Elias.
Affinity_Sari_EP12_007: Speaking in front of everyone... Being the Master isn't for just anyone.
Affinity_Sari_EP13_001: A while ago, a dragon named Kidian asked me how to talk with a friend.
Affinity_Sari_EP13_003: I told her to repeat what the other says and add "Amazing! Awesome!" and tadaaa! You got a conversation... I wasn't teasing. That's really my secret.
Affinity_Sari_EP13_004: Kidian being talkative like Sari... I can't imagine it.
Affinity_Sari_EP13_005: Are you implying I'm not of any help? How subtle of you...
Affinity_Sari_EP13_006: You helped someone with your skills
Affinity_Sari_EP14_001: I'm really curious if Master can make enthusiastic conversation like me...
Affinity_Sari_EP14_002: You're always so amazing at going along with the conversation! So awesome!
Affinity_Sari_EP14_003: You recognize my true value, Master! Awesome!
Affinity_Sari_EP14_004: Your very existence shines dazzlingly bright, Sari!
Affinity_Sari_EP14_006: Just vaguely playing along is so perfectly Sari-like!
Affinity_Sari_EP15_001: Sometimes I think you enjoy teasing me.
Affinity_Sari_EP15_002: You're just noticing now? Sari, you're amazing!
Affinity_Sari_EP15_003: You're teasing me by copying me right now, aren't you?
Affinity_Sari_EP15_004: No way. I'm always sincere with Sari.
Affinity_Sari_EP15_005: Are you... seriously trying to appeal to a phantom...?
Affinity_Sari_EP15_006: I just enjoy joking around with you.
Affinity_Sari_EP15_007: But... Phantoms are the ones who tease, not the ones who get teased.
Affinity_Sari_EP16_001: Being a Phantom gets tiring sometimes. I wish you'd understand me better.
Affinity_Sari_EP16_002: Sari, obsessed with conversation... are you a phantom of loneliness?
Affinity_Sari_EP16_003: I might be obsessed with conversation, but I don't think it's because I'm lonely.
Affinity_Sari_EP16_004: Sari, who can't talk about herself... are you a phantom of shyness?
Affinity_Sari_EP16_005: It's not really shyness... It's more like eating with your right hand your whole life and suddenly having to eat with your left.
Affinity_Sari_EP16_006: Then tell me what kind of phantom you are.
Affinity_Sari_EP16_007: But I want Master to guess. It's no fun if I just tell you.
Affinity_Sari_EP17_001: I recently happened to meet a Phantom named Xion.
Affinity_Sari_EP17_002: She must've said something like "You have found me hiding in the darkness!"
Affinity_Sari_EP17_004: What did you think of Xion after meeting her?
Affinity_Sari_EP17_005: She might be a phantom but didn't seem like one... She had no interest in pranks at all.
Affinity_Sari_EP17_007: Master, are you suddenly sharing your preferences!? Seems you have quite a refined taste!
Affinity_Sari_EP18_001: If this world is one giant show, are you having fun, Master?
Affinity_Sari_EP18_002: Every day's been spectacular since I came to Elias.
Affinity_Sari_EP18_003: It's about to get more fun. You know, there are phantoms who light up with sinister gleam in their eyes while watching you Master.
Affinity_Sari_EP18_004: If it's a show, that means someone's watching, right? That's creepy.
Affinity_Sari_EP18_005: Why? A show just needs to be entertaining.
Affinity_Sari_EP18_006: If this world is a show, what role do you play in it?
Affinity_Sari_EP18_007: I'd say a very enthusiastic extra.
Affinity_Sari_EP19_001: We can't even taste the food, so why do we come here?
Affinity_Sari_EP19_003: Huh...? Uh, well. Don't suddenly ask me what I think like that.
Affinity_Sari_EP19_004: Food isn't just about taste—it's also about style.
Affinity_Sari_EP19_005: Ooh... That sounded pretty convincing. That reaction came straight from the heart.
Affinity_Sari_EP19_006: Isn't food's just an excuse to meet other denizens?
Affinity_Sari_EP19_007: The good thing about this place is I don't have to worry about the conversation dying out.
Affinity_Sari_EP20_001: Shaydi is so cool. I wonder if she'll come crash the banquet hall around now?
Affinity_Sari_EP20_002: Why do the phantoms keep doing that?!
Affinity_Sari_EP20_003: Master, you don't understand the coolness of pranks! You're way too serious!
Affinity_Sari_EP20_004: I'm only putting up with this because I'm nice.
Affinity_Sari_EP20_005: Wow. What a generous and big-hearted Master! I guess I can prank you even more!
Affinity_Sari_EP20_006: Sari... Please don't be like that.
Affinity_Sari_EP20_007: Don't worry, I'm not the type to act on it.
